name: yacreader
description: Comic library server for browsing and serving your YACReader collection

fields.name: YACREADER_PORT
fields.label: R1: App Port
fields.help: Host port used to open YACReader Library Server in your browser.

fields.name: YACREADER_CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R2: Config Folder
fields.help: Stores YACReader Library Server configuration and application state.

fields.name: YACREADER_COMICS_LOCATION
fields.label: R3: Comics Folder
fields.help: Folder containing the comics library to serve through YACReader.

fields.name: PUID
fields.label: R4: PUID
fields.help: User ID used by the container for file permissions.

fields.name: PGID
fields.label: R5: PGID
fields.help: Group ID used by the container for file permissions.

fields.name: TZ
fields.label: O1: Timezone
fields.help:
Timezone used by YACReader logs and scheduled tasks.
Example: Europe/Madrid.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O2: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: YACREADER_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: A1: Network
fields.help: Choose the default bridge network, host networking, or an existing Docker network.

fields.name: YACREADER_IMAGE
fields.label: A2: Image
fields.help:
Docker image used for YACReader Library Server.
Change the tag to develop only if you intentionally want the development build.

fields.name: YACREADER_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Port mapping used when YACReader is not running in host mode.

fields.name: YACREADER_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: Recipe-managed container name from the source Compose example.

fields.name: YACREADER_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal App Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed YACReader Library Server internal web port.

ui.overview: YACReader Library Server serves your comic collection so it can be browsed from YACReader clients and a browser.
what_happens: A YACReader Library Server container will be created
The web interface will be published on the port you choose
Your config folder and comics library folder will be mounted into the container
Bridge networking is used by default, with optional host or existing-network choices under Advanced
ui.data_location: Relative paths are stored inside this app's project folder under the mounted EasyDocker base config path.
